GuidedTourPage.title: How to Use Oaziland
GuidedTourPage.subtitle: A quick walkthrough for every kind of user — pick the one that matches you.
GuidedTourPage.renterStep1Text: Use the Rent/Sale toggle on the home page, pick your neighborhood and property type, and browse real, verified listings.
GuidedTourPage.renterStep2Text: Every listing clearly shows whether it's from the property owner directly, an agent, or an agency — so you can choose who you'd rather work with.
GuidedTourPage.renterStep3Text: Tap 'Contact on WhatsApp' on any listing to message the lister directly — no middleman, no waiting.
GuidedTourPage.renterStep4Text: Oaziland also covers hotels, student hostels, event venues, and guest houses — all searchable the same way.
GuidedTourPage.landlordStep1Title: Create your account and verify your identity
GuidedTourPage.landlordStep1Text: Register, then complete the two-factor authentication and KYC steps — this is required before you can list a property, and it's what makes your listing trustworthy to renters and buyers.
GuidedTourPage.landlordStep2Text: Go to 'List a Property', choose Rent or Sale, and set your price. Your listing goes live after a quick review.
GuidedTourPage.landlordStep3Title: Boost your listing for more visibility
GuidedTourPage.landlordStep3Text: Purchase a boost to have your post or listing shown higher in search and in the social feed.
GuidedTourPage.landlordStep4Text: Listings expire after 90 days. You'll get reminders by WhatsApp before that happens, with a one-tap renew option.
GuidedTourPage.agentStep1Text: Once verified, your public agent profile shows your real listings and ratings — visible to anyone browsing, no account needed on their end.
GuidedTourPage.agentStep2Text: Your private dashboard shows your leads, commission, and — if you run an agency — your whole team's activity in one place.
GuidedTourPage.agentStep3Title: Respond to the Looking For board
GuidedTourPage.agentStep3Text: Browse real requests from people looking for a room, store, warehouse, or business, and respond directly if you have a match.
GuidedTourPage.agentStep4Text: Browse Training & Courses for property management, tenant law, and licensing prep — some issue a real certificate on completion.
GuidedTourPage.studentStep1Text: Browse verified student hostels, filter by room type, and see what's actually available.
GuidedTourPage.studentStep2Text: If you're sharing a room, set your sleep schedule, cleanliness, and noise preferences to help find a compatible roommate.
GuidedTourPage.studentStep3Text: Hostel billing can be split into installments rather than one lump sum — ask your hostel manager about this option.
GuidedTourPage.studentStep4Text: Share your personal referral code — once a friend you refer signs up and verifies their account, you earn a real reward.
